literal_meaning: টুকরো টুকরো করে বা ছোট ছোট অংশে করে
figurative_meaning_en: haphazardly, with great difficulty, somehow or other
example_sentences_in_english: The family is managing the household somehow.
They are running the business haphazardly.
note: This idiom reflects the resilience in Bengali everyday language for describing makeshift arrangements.
